claude_proposed_widenings.name: controllable_hazardous_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The sphere is a persistent world object with transient controller ownership, an action-based Arcana control attempt, a duration-limited control state, and a follow-up bonus-action movement command that resolves saves and damage when the object enters creature spaces. MagicItemMechanics only supports passive grants or single activated ability payloads; neither can honestly encode this stateful control loop.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you are within 60 feet of a sphere, you can take a Magic action to make a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn... While in control of the sphere, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to move in one direction of your choice...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: obliterate_creature_remains
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The sphere's damage has an extra deterministic rider when it reduces a creature to 0 HP: the creature is obliterated and leaves no physical remains, while possessions remain. Current effect atoms can deal damage, but they cannot express this corpse/remains state change.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains.
